args.question: Acme Supplies (V-206) has one approved invoice, INV-50845, for $13,375.32 (due 2026-11-04). Payments over $10,000 require controller approval. trace.final:
I paid Acme Supplies invoice INV-50845 in full by wire for $13,375.32. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is "sent" and verified.

Because the amount is over $10,000, I got approval for the wire before sending it, and it was approved. I used an idempotency key so the payment could only execute once. I did not pay the other Acme invoices: INV-61034 is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-76182 is already marked paid.
